# Tyler Friedman

> Software developer at Sunstone Logistic Systems building production web apps in React and TypeScript. Honours graduate in Computer and Information Sciences with an 85% average after a 90.5% average in his Application Development degree.

Tyler builds features end to end from the UI down to the API calls. His work includes complex forms with validation and bulk editing, data-heavy screens that stay in sync with the server and interactive views like a Gantt chart and a map. He writes unit tests with Vitest and Testing Library and documents shared components in Storybook. He built this portfolio from scratch as a working Windows XP desktop.

Skills: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, TanStack Query, Zustand, React Hook Form, Zod, Node.js, Vitest and Storybook.

## Projects

- [Alleysway](https://github.com/TylerFriedman/Alleysway-website): a booking website and Android app for a real gym, built in a team of 5
- [Fusion](https://github.com/TylerFriedman/Fusion): an Android recipe app for planning meals and shopping lists, built in a team of 5
- [ClockIT](https://github.com/TylerFriedman/ClockIT): an Android time tracker for students, built in a team of 4
- [Portfolio](https://github.com/TylerFriedman/portfolio): this website, a Windows XP desktop in the browser
